title: dreamDEX Perps Builder Bounty
description:
# dreamDEX Perps Builder Bounty

Stress-test the dreamDEX Perps API and SDK on testnet, and get paid for it.

The Perps Builder Bounty is a developer program for dreamDEX perps on **Somnia Tokyo testnet**. It runs from **October 19 to November 1** and has two tracks. You can enter one or both.

1. **Feedback:** find bugs, API and SDK issues, documentation gaps and missing features, and send reproducible reports. Every accepted report is paid.
2. **MVP:** build a perps product worth using, such as a trading bot, an AI agent, a trader tool or a consumer perps app. Three MVPs win $500 each.

# Who can submit

Registration is open to everyone. Only whitelisted emails can submit Builds.

- Selected builders from the dreamDEX Event Contracts hackathon are already whitelisted and get an invite by email and Telegram.
- Anyone else: open a ticket in the [dreamDEX Discord](https://discord.gg/dreamdex), or message us in the [SomniaHacks Telegram group](https://t.me/+s_oRMnGpOyQ3ODQ0), with the email you use on DoraHacks, and we add you to the whitelist.

# Prizes

**Feedback track, up to $1,500**

- $40 for each accepted critical or major item
- $15 for each other accepted item
- An item is accepted only if we can reproduce it. Only the first valid report of an issue is paid; duplicates are closed.
- Payouts stop once the $1,500 track budget is used.

**MVP track, 3 x $500**

- Three MVPs win $500 each, paid in two parts: $300 when the winners are announced, and $200 once the MVP runs on mainnet. The $200 is paid after the perps mainnet launch, if the MVP places orders on mainnet within 30 days of the launch.
- Each winner also gets a technical breakdown post on the [dreamDEX X account](https://x.com/DreamDEXSomnia).

## How to submit

Every Build needs a GitHub repository.

### Feedback track

Put each item in its own Markdown file in a `feedback/` folder in your repo, one file per issue:

```javascript
# Short title
Severity: critical | major | normal
Area: API | SDK | docs | app | contracts

## Steps to reproduce
1. ...

## Expected

## Actual

## Evidence
Transaction hash, request and response, screenshots

## Environment
SDK version, network (Somnia Tokyo testnet), wallet address
```

Found a security vulnerability? Do not put it in your repo. Send it privately to [security@dreamdex.io](mailto:security@dreamdex.io).

### MVP track

- Your MVP places real perps orders on Somnia Tokyo testnet.
- Your README explains what it does, who it is for and how to run it.
- Your README has an **X posts** section with links to 2 or 3 posts about your MVP that tag [@DreamDEXSomnia](https://x.com/DreamDEXSomnia).
- Categories: bots and agents, trader tools, consumer perps. Using Somnia primitives such as Reactivity or Somnia Agents is a plus.

# Testnet funds

Trade with your Perps Arena balance: join the Perps Arena on [app.testnet.dreamdex.io](https://app.testnet.dreamdex.io) and you receive paper USDso every week.

If your build needs more, ask us in Discord and tell us why. Extra USDso only goes to a bounty account that is not in the Perps Arena, and those wallets are monitored. Moving bounty USDso into a Perps Arena account is not allowed.

# Timeline

| Date | |
|---|---|
| October 19 | Bounty opens, perps introduction session |
| October 19 to 25 | Perps bot kit session |
| October 26 to November 1 | Quick build ideas session, MVP builds and X posts |
| November 1, 23:59 UTC | Submissions close |
| By November 8 | Results |

Session times are announced in the dreamDEX Discord and in the Announcements tab.

# Evaluation

**Feedback:** severity, clarity, reproducibility, and how useful the item is for the perps product and developer experience.

**MVP:**

1. MVP potential: clear user value, credible scope, a viral or repeat-use loop, technical execution
2. Evidence of building: live orders on Somnia Tokyo testnet, transaction hashes, repo and demo
3. Communication: quality and accuracy of your X posts

# Resources

- [Perps on testnet for developers](https://app.testnet.dreamdex.io/docs/developers/perps-testnet): network, contracts and SDK setup
- [Perps on testnet for traders](https://app.testnet.dreamdex.io/docs/trading/perps-testnet): orders, margin, funding
- [dreamDEX bot kit](https://github.com/somnia-chain/dreamdex-bot-kit): perps bot examples and strategies
- [dreamBot Builder](https://app.testnet.dreamdex.io/dreambot-builder) and the [Link a Bot guide](https://app.testnet.dreamdex.io/docs/trading/common/link-a-bot)
- [Somnia Markets SDK docs](https://somnia-platform-docs.vercel.app/markets/somnia-markets)
- Questions: [dreamDEX Discord](https://discord.gg/dreamdex), the [SomniaHacks Telegram group](https://t.me/+s_oRMnGpOyQ3ODQ0) or the Ask Question tab on this page
